title: Standard10-prior state-conditioned residual-regret smoke
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: An exact-v6 external-sampling regret learner that adds state-conditioned cumulative-regret residuals to frozen Standard10 action log-probabilities can preserve the mature policy at zero residual while learning alternative-action credit that generalizes better than global bias search, local PPO margins, single-teacher imitation, or from-zero Deep CFR.
material_change: Add an optional strategy provider to the exact ChipState CFR traversal and a numerically checked prior-residual strategy. Train a bounded fresh-reinit residual bundle from frozen Standard10, then compare its fixed LCFR-weighted greedy ensemble with unchanged Standard10 on common-deck generic and learned anchors.
baseline: Frozen Standard10 SHA256 91b0c587a5a76e9a8f38217e0b304136ef298118a99b69cc743899fc4b16e428; from-zero Deep CFR snapshot was -473.5109 bb/100 versus it. Historical imitation teacher remained -18.5025 fresh20k and is not reused.
notes: Preregistered mechanism smoke. Frozen Standard10 remains unchanged; candidate execution is a fixed LCFR-weighted residual ensemble with greedy action choice. No Slumbot hands.

result.summary: Eight exact-v6 training roots generated 23,476 decision nodes and a reload-exact Standard10-prior residual bundle. Zero residual reproduced Standard10 on 368 states with zero greedy mismatches. The learned ensemble had positive point deltas on 4/4 anchors, including +27.7344 bb/100 versus Standard10, but every CI crossed zero and greedy disagreement was 83.5-88.9%.
result.conclusion: State-conditioned residual regret is mechanically valid and yields the first positive all-anchor bounded direction after the from-zero rejection, but scale1 rewrites most Standard10 decisions and the estimates are too imprecise for strength claims. It admits a frozen residual-dose control only, not more training or Slumbot.
result.next_step: Use the unchanged frozen residual bundle for a preregistered residual-scale dose scan on development decks, then confirm only the smallest preservation-compatible positive scale on disjoint decks before considering more CFR roots.
